FilterCheck.description:
One filter part: data matched with the full filter versus with this part dropped.

A listed item (a folder, rule UID, Sentry project, Wazuh agent or group, Cloudflare
hostname) widens the selection instead of narrowing it: its `matched` is what the item
selects within the rest of the filter and `matched_without` is null.

available.description: Values that exist for this field within the rest of the filter.
available.title: Available

matched.description: With the full filter; null when unknown.
matched.title: Matched

matched_without.description: With this part dropped; null when not applicable or failed.
matched_without.title: Matched Without

matching.description: The values of `available` this part accepts.
matching.title: Matching

part.description: The part as configured, e.g. env=~"prod|qa".
part.title: Part

attributes.description: Descriptive labels, e.g. error_type; not identity.

confidence_reasons.description: Every factor that lowered confidence; empty when high.

error_kinds.description: Error kinds with events during a finding on a Sentry project's errors, most events first.

observed.description: Peak observed value in the episode.

summary.description: What the finding means (2.7); null for custom rules.

``name<op>"value"`` matcher, e.g. ``env="prod"`` or ``env=~"prod|staging"``.

without ``env``.

MetricSeries.description:
One scoped series on a regular grid: values[i] is at start + i * step_seconds.

`None` is a gap (no sample), never zero.

coverage.description: Share of steps with a sample.
